name: focus
description: Focus — a personal operating system for projects, routines, events, trips and everything worth coming back to.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix client run test && npm --prefix server run test

comments.workspaces: Deliberately NOT an npm workspace. client/ and server/ are independent projects with their own node_modules; these scripts are conveniences only. See docs/PROJECT_STATE.md decision 1.
comments.test: Vitest covers client/src/lib — the pure rules (recurrence, urgency, relevance, templates, migrations). The server has no tests yet and its script is still a notice.
comments.checkLinks: Fails if a placeholder destination (example.com, url:"#") is written into client source. See scripts/check-links.mjs.
